mode: Read-only code integration design using already sealed human criteria and genuine26 legal evidence. No product/test edits, compilers, runs or engine queries for this design.

first_missing_common_operation.finding: Represent and verify a separately owned later realization of the same original action/destination at its actual observed prefix, with current access/provider/transaction evidence, before assigning any local value.
first_missing_common_operation.why_not_rebase: FunctionalReplyReading.rebase297 only substitutes current owned paths retaining every exact represented prefix/occurrence/position and the old predicate. A different provider is a new board witness, not a rebase of the Nd2-control proof.
first_missing_common_operation.why_not_same_pv: The owned full Qd3 pool work6 has a different plan with no Rd6, while the work7 named comparison includes a late Rd6. Both retain their own numerical owners. Neither the old event sequence nor late Rd6 is necessary to all useful Qd3 realizations.
first_missing_common_operation.why_not_replace_root_condition: Root condition Nd2 control d6 is still the honest original comparison. At the late Nb1 line the original knight is captured; a new queen proof may explain one realization but cannot certify that the root retained its knight support.
first_missing_common_operation.why_not_a_new_san_pattern: The operation depends on exact canonical original actor, destination, current legal catalogue and complete current transaction inventory, with no book identifier or SAN branch.

minimal_extension_contract.preserve: Keep the original Resource, RootOwner, root condition, old LegalReplyOption proof validation and current finite Task complete semantics unchanged.
minimal_extension_contract.function_identity: For this initial bounded scope, key by existing resource owner, canonically tracked original user, action/destination and purpose relation. Do not require the original provider, a permanent role label, or exact future event route. Different-user realizations remain a separate later scope rather than being silently merged.
minimal_extension_contract.new_scoped_realization: A private checked realization contains original Resource owner; source Checked own-choice certificate or exact admitted returned source; full observed prefix plus occurrence/position identity; same original user/current row; current provider originals; complete legal capture/recovery/second-recapture snapshot; admitted display/price paths. Each has explicit packet/prepared owner.
minimal_extension_contract.candidate_source: Inspect only an existing owned useful alternative or selected response path that actually contains the same original user/destination later. A local probe is not a new evaluated plan. Start with one earliest eligible observed realization per source/function; unexplored later uses stay explicit unknown.
minimal_extension_contract.factual_validation: Require complete legal rows at current decision and each transaction position, exact original actor surviving to arrival, exact action row including capture/promotion/check and destination, actual new provider identity, source references at actual positions. Unknown is not Some(Nil). The snapshot must equal freshly reread canonical sorted/distinct complete inventory.
minimal_extension_contract.price_snapshot: For every currently legal opposing capture of the arriving user, retain every immediate legal own recapture, and every immediate opponent capture of each recapturer. Include check-response constraints and any selected deeper price needed by a claimed conclusion. A complete shallow snapshot is factual; it cannot label a square safe, a sacrifice unsound or a plan useful.
minimal_extension_contract.factual_display: Use existing ControlState/PieceAbsence/PieceRoute/Continuation/material statements for primitive observed facts and closed prices. If a sentence explicitly claims the recapture mechanism or complete capture set, add one small typed current-realization statement with a private checked constructor; do not loosen LegalReplyOption two-root proof requirements to encode a one-arm late fact.
minimal_extension_contract.value_stage: A separate optional local stage owns CompareMoves at this exact prefix, an unrestricted full current own pool selecting strongestOther, an exact same-profile/depth current pair if the full pool cannot itself answer it, and completed full opponent resistance after both selected action and preferred/competitive other when the comparison sentence relies on both plans. Known legal capture counters absent from a top3 pool retain their own comparison/refutation obligations.
minimal_extension_contract.not_global_completion: Late optional stage completion is separate from original Task.complete/root assessment. Factual realization may remain in detail while value is pending. Current Task.complete does not certify every future realization, every legal reply or whole original score cause.
minimal_extension_contract.renderer: Decision must use stage.prefix.size rather than literal2/3. State the exact local phase, current provider, selected/refuted action, useful alternative, actual leading resistance and separately conditional capture price. Original root judgment remains unchanged; avoid replaying a long path as though forced.
minimal_extension_contract.caller_and_ui: Reducer withQuestions/pendingChoiceTask and RuntimeProtocol context transport can reuse current comparison receipts. Add supported immutable stage FactGroup/facts identifying exact prefix/user/destination/current context before granting whole survey ownership. UI must require those facts, root answer/current owner, complete legal position and exact work/proposalRefs; merely removing prefix2/3 checks is insufficient.
minimal_extension_contract.provenance_boundary: Compact Source provenance should name existing proposal/context/fact IDs and exact current work IDs/keys. Public FactReader results and answer evidence keep their full eligible occurrence refs separately. Do not filter or truncate exact proof refs to fit Source256.
minimal_extension_contract.bounded_root_connection: A local late value is conditional on its prefix. Attributing it to Nc4/Nb1 or Rfd1 requires matched root/reply scopes or independently completed original adequate defense families and other own plans; no sole cp explanation or study-score graft.

Then complete actually needed new work and read BASIC independently against frozen criteria, separating bounded local insight from whole original judgment.
